subject: anyone want to make a wordpress page/shiny/R/map for wikispeedia.org?

messages.subject: anyone want to make a wordpress page/shiny/R/map for wikispeedia.org?
parts:
Hi,

We need a simple map/edit page for speed limits.

Its for a charity I help run called wikispeedia.
Scott Chamberlain made Rwikispeedia for us if that helps...

But recently I learned about Wordpress so I was wondering if anyone would like to do this gratis or cheap?

Just a map where people can edit the dots (speed limit sign locations). Something like this but with edits...

Please help. We have been doing this for 7 years free of charge, just funding wikispeedia by selling android apps...

You can monetize the page. It can host anywhere or on wikispeedia.org. Your call.....

Jim Pruett, Director
wikispeedia
spe...@wikispeedia.org
